# GIS Map Online

> GISMap.online is a free, open-source, browser-based GIS workspace for people and AI agents to explore, style and share geographic data in 2D and 3D. A language model can make a map for someone by producing a URL: no API key, account or server call is needed. It opens public ArcGIS REST (FeatureServer, MapServer, ImageServer), GeoJSON, WMS, WFS and KML sources over HTTPS.

The map in a link is one JSON object (map-v1): layers with filters and styles, basemap, camera. Write it after #map=json: in the URL. Invalid parts are skipped and reported; the rest of the map still opens.

## Choose and combine agent recipes

| User asks for… | Agent selects… | Primary artifact |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Map this data and color it by population | [interactive-map](https://gismap.online/skills/#recipe-interactive-map) | Filtered, styled interactive map |
| Create slides about these districts | [interactive-briefing](https://gismap.online/skills/#recipe-interactive-briefing) | Map-based briefing |
| Show me these locations in sequence | [geographic-tour](https://gismap.online/skills/#recipe-geographic-tour) | Guided geographic tour |
| Inspect this location and complete these tasks | [field-tasks](https://gismap.online/skills/#recipe-field-tasks) | Five-task fieldwork package |
| Make the county heights represent acreage | [3d-extrusion](https://gismap.online/skills/#recipe-3d-extrusion) | 3D extruded map |
| Separate overlapping events by year and height | [spatial-3d-chart](https://gismap.online/skills/#recipe-spatial-3d-chart) | 3D spatial chart and five-scene Brief |
| Make the map feel like Halloween in California | [vibe-map](https://gismap.online/skills/#recipe-vibe-map) | Coordinated theme and styled map |

Combine recipes for one request: a 3D fire-history map with chronological strata, a five-slide briefing and a QR uses interactive-map, spatial-3d-chart and interactive-briefing. Check compatibility, virtual-Z semantics, actual outputs and reopening; do not assume every combination is portable.

## Make a map from a URL (no code)
- One layer: `https://gismap.online/?layer=<HTTPS service URL>&layerType=feature`
- Styled: add `&style=choropleth&field=<FIELD>&method=auto&ramp=greens&exclude=-1&basemap=gray-vector` (`method=auto` picks the class breaks from the data)
- Not sure which style suits the field: `&style=auto&field=<FIELD>` lets the app choose
- Full control: `https://gismap.online/#map=json:<URI-encoded map-v1 JSON>` (at most 8192 characters) or `?spec=<URL of a hosted map-v1 JSON file>`
- Inspect a service's fields first: append `?f=pjson` to the layer URL.
- Worked example: https://gismap.online/#map=json:%7B%22version%22%3A1%2C%22basemap%22%3A%22gray-vector%22%2C%22layers%22%3A%5B%7B%22url%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fservices.arcgis.com%2FP3ePLMYs2RVChkJx%2FArcGIS%2Frest%2Fservices%2FCorn%2FFeatureServer%2F0%22%2C%22renderer%22%3A%7B%22type%22%3A%22choropleth%22%2C%22field%22%3A%22CORN_SALES_IN_DOLLARS%22%2C%22method%22%3A%22auto%22%2C%22ramp%22%3A%22greens%22%2C%22exclude%22%3A%5B-1%5D%7D%7D%5D%7D

## Finish and verify the map
1. Retrieve source metadata (append ?f=pjson), inspect actual fields and query real filter values; do not guess field names. Check the publisher's null and sentinel conventions.
2. Construct a map-v1 spec and validate it and its renderer. In code, mapSpec.prepareVerification(spec) returns a URL and an offline report; metadata, filtering, rendering and reopening remain not_checked until independently tested.
3. Generate the canonical URL using mapSpec.createLink or URI-encoded #map=json: JSON. Return the actual URL to the user.
4. With browser access, open it, wait for layers, check issues and verify the intended features, filter, style and camera. Reopen the share URL and check again. State explicitly what you could not check.
5. Use precise status: prepared (constructed), validated (validator accepted, review warnings), loaded (layers loaded), verified (intended map and reopened link confirmed). A plausible URL alone is not verified. See the agent guide for tested filters and a Michigan county example.

Follow-up refinement: [derive year and acreage maps from one filtered California fire map](https://gismap.online/examples/ai/california-fire-refinement/). Preserve the source, filter, basemap and camera; use map-v1 when a simple URL is insufficient. The linked example reports which checks remain unverified.

## Contracts
- [Map spec schema](https://gismap.online/schemas/map-v1.schema.json): layers, renderers, filters, camera, basemap
- [Renderer schema](https://gismap.online/schemas/renderer-v1.schema.json): choropleth, graduated symbols, categories, heat map, simple
- [Briefing schema](https://gismap.online/schemas/briefing-v1.schema.json): slides that present a map
- [URL parameters](https://gismap.online/api/url-parameters.json): every query and fragment parameter
- [Capabilities](https://gismap.online/api/capabilities.json): in-page API, tools, error codes, limits
- [Application manifest](https://gismap.online/api/manifest.json) and [API explorer](https://gismap.online/api/explorer/): privacy-safe state and live registry discovery
- [TypeScript types](https://gismap.online/js/gismap-core.d.ts)

## Guides
- [GISMap Agent Skill](https://gismap.online/skills/): installable instructions, validation and implementation proposal
- [Making maps with an AI agent](https://gismap.online/guides/ai-agents/): chat-only, code-running and browser-driving recipes
- [AI ArcGIS map generator](https://gismap.online/ai-arcgis-map-generator/): inspect a FeatureServer, style a map, and share a working link
- [ArcGIS FeatureServer viewer](https://gismap.online/arcgis-feature-service-viewer/)

## Worked examples
- [A police divisions briefing, from one prompt or one click](https://gismap.online/examples/ai/philadelphia-police-divisions/): Philadelphia's six police divisions, with the police districts inside them, as a nine-slide interactive briefing on a dark 3D map, opened from one link or QR code.
- [A two-layer briefing with spatial queries, built by an agent](https://gismap.online/examples/ai/mlb-ballparks-by-state/): An AI agent built a ten-slide briefing that shows each state with only the Major League ballparks inside it, using a spatial query per slide, an automatic style and cut transitions.
- [A styled map in one link, written by a chatbot](https://gismap.online/examples/ai/corn-sales-one-link/): Any chatbot, even one that cannot run code, can make a styled county map by writing one JSON object into a link: corn sales by county, with "Not Disclosed" counties kept out of the colour classes.
- [A guided tour of eight classic ballparks](https://gismap.online/examples/tours/classic-ballparks/): A guided tour that flies the 3D map from Fenway Park to Petco Park, with a caption at each of eight ballparks, opened from one link or QR code.
- [A field task and its report, sent as two links](https://gismap.online/examples/field-tasks/opening-day-wayfinding/): A two-ballpark field check sent as a link or QR code, and the completed report that comes back the same way: check-in, steps, features and notes, with no server.

## Data
- [Curated public datasets (JSON)](https://gismap.online/api/catalog.json): 15 services with ready links

## Limits
- At most 10 layers per map; HTTPS only; URLs containing tokens or keys are refused; sources must allow browser (CORS) access.
- Basemaps: topo-3d, navigation-3d, navigation-dark-3d, osm-3d, gray-3d, dark-gray-3d, streets-3d, streets-dark-3d, topo-vector, streets-vector, navigation, gray-vector, dark-gray-vector, osm, satellite, hybrid, usgs-imagery, usgs-imagery-topo, open-liberty, open-bright, open-positron, open-dark, open-fiord, skin.
- Colour ramps: greens, blues, reds, oranges, purples, viridis, magma, red-blue-diverging, brown-teal-diverging.
